correctness.rationale: Proposition 4.2 of the cited paper proves full geometric automorphism group C3, genus four and p-rank two for the exact c=0 equation; elementary Galois cohomology gives three F3-forms. Both poles of order two contribute one rational point over each finite extension, yielding the trace formula. A dependency-free finite-field checker enumerates all 12 point counts, rederives all three degree-eight zeta numerators, and tests the mod-2 quartic and mod-5 quadratic/sextic irreducibility certificates. The disjoint allowed degrees rule out rational factors; Tate’s finite-field criterion gives simplicity and distinct isogeny classes. All hypotheses and field-of-definition restrictions are explicit.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural arithmetic classification for the three F3-forms of a newly introduced minimal-geometric-automorphism genus-four curve. It determines exact Weil numerators and the unexpectedly distinct F3-isogeny classes of their simple Jacobians, while the curves and polarized Jacobians become identical geometrically. Automorphism minimality makes the finite three-form set intrinsic; the exact values are not consequences of genus, p-rank, or geometric automorphism group alone. A general-purpose arithmetic fact becomes a concrete set of reproducible benchmarks for arithmetic descent and moduli.
